name: Process Monitor
description: A task manager scoped to TEDI. Shows the whole process tree the app owns: the window, the WebView2 renderer, the PTY daemon, every terminal shell and everything those shells started, plus the extension sidecars. AI CLIs attached to a terminal (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, opencode and friends) are called out with their own badge. The status bar carries the tree's total memory and a live CPU reading; clicking it opens the full tree with per-process CPU and memory. Reads the OS process table once per poll; nothing is killed, written or sent anywhere.
author: IlhamRiski - ilhamriski.com
